Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified which figure was the “historian” in the WebSurfer’s results. Despite the sources explicitly naming Ibn Khaldun as a “Tunisian historian,” the Planner selected Al-Ghazali (a Persian theologian) and concluded “Persian,” leading to an incorrect answer. This reflects an entity resolution error and premature task completion without proper synthesis of the retrieved information.
